messages:
maria_cs: Quick check-in — BridgeClient onboarding hit a spike of 429s right after we handed them the Node SDK. They reported preflight 401 followed by a bunch of 429s. Can the infra/eng team weigh in? :thinking:

zara_support: Thanks for the ping. I got their logs — they do a client-side warmup that opens ~150 parallel preflight/token requests on cold start. Throwing snippet here:
```
2026-03-20T14:03:21Z preflight 401 /v1/auth -> refresh
2026-03-20T14:03:21Z preflight 429 /v1/preflight (rate_limit)
2026-03-20T14:03:21Z retry token fetch -> 429
```

devon_eng: Looks like a classic ephemeral-token fanout + no splay. If they have many replicas starting at once the gateway preflight quota will trip. We usually recommend small jitter + exponential backoff on preflight. :thumbsup:

liam_se: @devon_eng could you confirm whether the customer's token TTL is default short (30s) or longer? Short TTL + many parallel preflights makes the window worse.

devon_eng: I checked their account config — they're using ephemeral tokens with 20s lifetime. That explains repeated refreshes. Options: increase TTL to 5m for onboarding/staging, or gate preflight with a single refresh per process and share in-memory token.

maria_cs: From a CS perspective we prefer minimal changes in their code. Can we offer a temporary server-side mitigation so they can keep their SDK config?

ops_bot: [rate-limiter] Policy applied to tenant bridgeclient-inc: preflight_per_minute=300, concurrent_preflight_burst=50. Current 1m window: avg=420, peak=1523 -> throttled.

devon_eng: We can temporarily raise concurrent_preflight_burst to 200 for their staging project and add a short advisory to reduce parallel initial connections. But raising limits in prod requires approval.

zara_support: I'll propose changing their SDK init to: single token fetch + share, and add 150-300ms random jitter before retry. Snippet for Node SDK:
```js
// single-token pattern
let tokenPromise = null;
function getToken() {
  if (!tokenPromise) tokenPromise = fetchTokenFromServer().finally(()=> setTimeout(()=> tokenPromise=null, tokenTTL-500));
  return tokenPromise;
}
// add jitter before preflight
await sleep(Math.random()*300);
```

liam_se: Also adding client-side backoff cut at ~8 concurrent preflights per instance usually avoids gateway bursts. We should surface a quick template in onboarding docs.

maria_cs: Good. Plan: 1) @devon_eng raise staging burst cap to 200 (temporary) 2) @zara_support send code snippet + one-pager to BridgeClient and ask them to patch init 3) follow up in 48h and revert cap. I'll own the customer comms.

devon_eng: I bumped the staging cap and left an audit note. Will not touch prod without PM/SE signoff.

zara_support: Sent the patch request and example PR link to their eng lead. They acknowledged and will ship today. :rocket:

maria_cs: Awesome — keep me posted. If they still hit >1k peaks we may need a short canary rollout with proxy fan-in adjustments.

liam_se: I'll draft a short onboarding doc section called "Preventing preflight stampedes" with patterns + recommended token TTLs. Will share for review.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Closing the immediate triage — will reopen if 429s persist. :handshake:
